limitsToPreserve: Al2O3(l) is expressly a molten-electrolyte process shorthand for dissolved alumina, not pure molten alumina; do not remove that qualifier or present it as strict species-level phase evidence.
Do not treat absence of a direct matrix model link as absence of teaching: 2.33C/2.40C/2.49 reuse explicit neutralisation/hydration records; supplemental reuse links recorded here.
Rust/air-tarnish variable composition and physical tests need truthful representation boundaries, not fabricated fixed formulae.
Family coverage is source-constrained. No universal acid×metal/base/carbonate matrix, no extra required industrial steps and no physical trials inferred.
